name: council-review
description: Empirical, adversarial research review for Claude. A twelve-seat Council of Elrond panel judges papers, proposals, and live code+results against an extended gate ladder: the empirical core (provenance, seed variance, specification robustness, specificity, confound control, mechanism, claim calibration) plus a methodology-completeness tier (external validity, measurement reliability, reproducibility, ethics/safety, analytic integrity/preregistration), a quantitative Type I/II error-analysis pass, a conditional figure-integrity review, and a conditional theoretical-soundness gate. The review self-calibrates (per-finding confidence, abstains when evidence-blocked, guards its own reviewer biases, verifies the load-bearing finding, and runs a final coherence pass before the verdict) and maps onto non in-silico reporting standards (CONSORT/STROBE/PRISMA/ARRIVE) for clinical and biomedical work. A development stance adds generative paper-writing feedback and a Reviewer-2 pre-mortem.
